green/700.use: the wordmark green, light chrome (the app's accent in light)

green/400.use: the brand hue lifted for dark chrome: the meter, the ring, the wave on ink

green/200.use: the design system's UI-and-code green highlight (unused on the phone yet)

green/100.use: the design system's UI-and-code green fill (unused on the phone yet)

green/mist.use: the pale green the orb lightens into

cobolt.use: AssemblyAI's primary violet: the drop, never a key or a surface

violet/lavender.use: the orb's lightest violet: its top and the gradient's ends

violet/periwinkle.use: the orb's mid violet: the drop's halo

violet/iris.use: the orb gradient's upper violet stop

ink.use: the brand ink: the Mac pill's body, the ink theme's surface

ink/800.use: a modifier key on ink; the Mac's dark card fill

ink/700.use: an ordinary key on ink, one step up

warm-white.use: key legends on ink: warm white on warm ink

card.use: the warm card fill; the paper theme's surface

card-border.use: the card's hairline; the paper theme's modifier key

orange.use: the error word and ring, cancel, the Full Access note; never a red body

apple/light-modifier.use: the iPhone keyboard's light modifier key

apple/dark-modifier.use: the iPhone keyboard's dark modifier key

paper/page.use: the design system's page: the app's light ground

paper/tint.use: the warm off-white one step in: light cards, dark legends

paper/300.use: neutral-200: a modifier key on the light face

paper/400.use: neutral-300: hairlines and field borders on the light face

neutral/900.use: black-400: body text on the light face

neutral/700.use: black-300: muted text and mono labels on the light face

neutral/500.use: black-200: mono labels on the dark face

kb/surface.use: the design face's surface (Figma binds to kb/*; Swift reads the palette)

kb/signal.use: the wave, the caret, the saved check

kb/notice-error.use: the solid ring and glyph for an error

kb/full-access-note.use: the one line of words the keyboard ever shows

kb/legend-secondary.use: the mono word labels (123, ABC, return, space) and the + at rest

app/page-light.use: the catalog's Page in light: the design system's page

app/page-dark.use: the catalog's Page in dark: ink, the website's ground

app/muted-light.use: the catalog's Muted in light: eyebrows, captions, secondary text

app/cta-light.use: the catalog's CTA in light: the one green button

app/cta-dark.use: the catalog's CTA in dark: the site's button green

app/cta-text-dark.use: the catalog's CTAText in dark: ink on green, as the site

key/height.use: every key: the iPhone's cap height (apple-geometry.json)

margin/side.use: at the keyboard's sides: the iPhone's cap margin, (402 − 10 letters − 9 gaps) / 2

margin/vertical.use: the keyboard's top, and the slim bar's bottom

key/radius.use: flat keys, one colour at this corner: the iPhone's (fitted 8.17)

key/min-width.use: a key that isn't given a width: the iPhone's 123 key at 402 pt

key/letter-width-402.use: a letter key at 402 pt: (width − 2 × margin/side − 9 × key/gap) / 10

key/side-width-402.use: shift and delete at 402 pt: what seven letters and the side gaps leave, halved (measured 45.5)

key/return-width-402.use: return at 402 pt: two 123 keys and a gap

voicebar/height.use: the voice row, where the system puts its suggestion bar

voicebar/note-gap.use: between the orb and the Full Access note

voicebar/addterm-clearance.use: the wave stays this clear of the + at the trailing edge

popup/extra-width.use: the letter pop-up is the key width plus this

popup/offset.use: the pop-up sits this far above the key

caret/lead.use: the caret's gap from the text

panel/spacing.use: between the panel's orb and its key row

picker/preview-width.use: the theme card draws the keyboard at this width

picker/scale.use: then scales it to fit two across

layout/panel.use: chosen: room for the 96 orb over one key row

opacity/press-brighten.use: a key lightens this much while pressed

opacity/legend.use: key legends over the cap; below 1 they sit back

opacity/surface-vignette.use: a soft darkening toward the surface's edges; 0 is none

surface/vignette-start.use: where the vignette begins, as a fraction of the keyboard's width

margin/bottom-keys.use: under a bottom row of keys (the full keyboard, the panel): the iPhone's

key/side-gap.use: shift and delete stand this far from the letters: the iPhone's

key/reference-width.use: the width the @402 tokens were measured at (iPhone 18 Pro); widths scale from it

key/abc-width-402.use: 123 and the globe at 402 pt: the iPhone's

key/space-width-402.use: space at 402 pt beside 123, the globe and return: what is left (measured 191.333)

voice/bar-width.use: the voice element's box in the voice bar: what the wave gets

voice/home-width.use: the box on the home screen

opacity/off.use: the element when Blurt isn't ready: a tap opens the app

opacity/sheen.use: the light passing over the element at rest: chrome catching light

opacity/glint.use: the cross glint when the words land

radius/button.use: the brand's buttons and the grille: rectangular, never a pill

radius/input.use: the brand's inputs: the key-term field

grille/pitch.use: the dot lattice: one dot every

grille/bar-width.use: the grille in the voice bar

grille/home-width.use: the grille on the home screen

opacity/grille-rest.use: the dots at rest, over the key colour

grille/glint-arm.use: the cross glint's vertical arm, as a fraction of the grille's height

grille/sheen-width.use: the sheen's band, as a fraction of the width

ribs/rest-width.use: the ribs asleep: the wave's own bars at rest

streak/point.use: the bright point at the centre

streak/arm.use: the landing flash's vertical arm, as a fraction of the box's height

opacity/grain-dark.use: film grain over the dark face: matte, the brand's texture

opacity/grain-light.use: film grain over the light face: paper, lighter

term/radius.use: the key-term field: the brand's input corners (radius/input)

key/pad.use: a legend's side padding on a min-width key

app/header-height.use: the home header: wordmark and gear

app/stack-gap.use: between a section's eyebrow and its content, and between cards

app/icon.use: the header's gear, the copy glyph

app/preview-gap.use: between the theme card's two faces

opacity/pressed.use: a brand button while pressed: a colour change, no lift

size/letter.use: letter keys: the iPhone's (estimated from the l glyph, apple-geometry.json)

size/label.use: the mono word labels on keys: 123, ABC, #+=, space, the return label

size/eyebrow.use: a mono eyebrow in the app (E1)

size/cta.use: a mono button label in the app (E2)

tracking/eyebrow.use: uppercase mono at 12: the brand's E1 tracking

tracking/cta.use: uppercase mono at 14: the brand's E2 tracking

ratio/voice-glyph.use: the clipboard and exclamation glyphs, as a fraction of the voice element's height

wave-fade.use: the orb and the wave crossing, either way

state-fade.use: every other change on the key: the ring, a glyph, the dimming

term-swap.use: the voice bar becoming the field

press.use: the orb's press; the one thing that answers at once

ring-period.use: one turn of the ring, the Mac's cadence

colour.use: a colour or fill changing state: the brand's transition

landing.use: the glint when the words land

ease/signature.use: the house curve for everything that moves; nothing springs

sheen.use: one pass of the light over the element at rest

sheen-working.use: and while something is happening: the ring's cadence

mono/family.use: eyebrows, CTAs, the keyboard's word labels

heading/family.use: the app's serif headlines, sentence case, tight
